title: Global Config Guide
subheading: Step-by-step guide to using the global config instead of the portable config.

contents.Text: The [[[strong:use global config]]] button has been removed, due to Windows file system restrictions and complexity.
Instead, simply relocate the [[[strong:RhythmiRust_config]]] folder to one of the following locations:
By doing so, you will be using the [[[strong:global config]]] instead of the [[[strong:portable config]]]. This means you can use the same config for all of your RhythmiRust installations.
Thus when updating RhythmiRust, you do not have to worry about where to put the binary/executable.
[[[warning:Note:]]] The [[[strong:portable config]]] is simply a folder named [[[strong:RhythmiRust_config]]], which is always created right next to where the executable is.
[[[strong:Settings -> About:]]] This page shows the [[[strong:Config path]]] and the [[[strong:Log path]]] that are currently in use.
To quickly grab the current config path, [[[strong:double-click]]] it and press [[[strong:CTRL + C]]] to copy it.
